title: Appending pagination after click

comments.body: Hi @Maaark, could you provide a jsFiddle for us to work on? That would speed a lot the debugging process. Thanks!
@Maaark Do you just want a pagination widget that displays "show more" and once clicked show more results? You will be able to show maximum 1000 hits (but that's already a lot).

Yeah, that part is already working, but the issue is that we want to store the state in the url, like the other widgets already do. So there should be a extra query parameter in the url, for example paginator=5.

When the visitor refreshes the page or when he visited a productpage and uses the back button in the browser we need to show the number of results that the visitor was looking at, for example 50 products.

Woow... that simple :) Awesome!
I tried it before by setting the hitsperpage, but each time I clicked the button the page loading got slower and slower, when I had 200 results per page it was unusable, but your code doesn't has this issue :)

I do have 1 issue with your code, when I apply a filter I want to reset the hitsperpage to the default value, how do I do that?

> when I apply a filter I want to reset the hitsperpage to the default value, how do I do that?

Hmm this is not currently doable sadly, we have #1068 that would allow you to do custom actions when you refine on something.

In the meantime I do not see any quickfix to do that.
Ok, no problem. This is good enough for now 👍
